title: 第18章 严峻局势第17章 法朗克龙脉
content_zh:
与此同时，还有几位来自各个顶尖猎魔家族的猎魔者，也注意到了凯撒的动向。
他们其中一些人在看到青年长相的刹那，脸上的神色便骤然僵住，眼中满是敬畏。
气氛沉寂了片刻之后，其中一名手持特制战斧的猎魔大师，忍不住咽了口唾沫：“这一位……不会也是来参加勇士天梯的吧？”
而在他身旁，另一名皮甲上绣有岩浆鱼徽记的猎魔大师缓缓摇了摇头，目光始终没有离开青年的背影。
“应该不是。以这位在地狱岛上展现出来的力量来看，我们在他眼里和蚂蚁没什么区别。”
两人身后一名腰间挂满了魔药的猎魔大师同样点了点头，哪怕现在想起地狱岛上的战斗，他心里还是一阵后怕
那种层次的战斗余波，光是靠近就有死亡的危机：“以这位的实力来看，估计是来见那位主宰的。”
最终，几人隐晦地交谈了片刻，还是打消了上前攀谈的念头。
对方那种层次的存在，恐怕早就已经记不清他们这些凡俗猎魔人了……
而另一侧，凯撒并没有理会周围窥视的目光，依旧面带笑意地看向身旁的龙人。
龙纹青年则死死盯着凯撒，脸上是前所未有的凝重：“你到底是谁？！”
刚才那股力量简直就像一片无尽深渊，哪怕自己拼尽全力挣扎，也完全无法挣脱。
这种感觉，就算是父亲也绝对办不到，其中的差距大到让人升不起反抗的心思。
凯撒有些无奈地耸了耸肩，实在懒得回答这种需要很久才能讲清楚的问题。
自己的身份说起来过于复杂，真要讲起来，一时半会恐怕连皮毛都说不完。
“臭小子，我这把老骨头都要散架了！”就在他准备敷衍几句的时候，身后传来了老乞丐有气无力的抱怨声。
老乞丐望着眼前这座熟悉又陌生的冰山王城，心中不禁暗自感叹……自己终究是老了。
凯撒轻轻拍了拍老乞丐的肩膀，又看了看身后气喘吁吁的卡莎和萨丽：“那你跟上来干什么？难道也想去见见苏尔特？”
老乞丐脸上难得浮现出一丝傲然之色，拍着胸脯指了指王城：“我就勉为其难给你当一回向导，这里面的规则可多着呢……而且还有不少难缠的东西。”
话音落下，身旁的龙纹青年便满脸震惊地瞪大了眼，死死盯着凯撒的背影。

他本来以为这家伙是来参加勇士天梯的强者，但没想到居然是来找那位主宰的。
“凯撒……”他死死盯着青年的侧脸，总感觉这个名字在哪里听到过，似乎在帝国西部边境流传得极为广泛。
于是他赶忙从胸口掏出几张羊皮纸，开始仔细对照着上面的图案。
只见羊皮纸上印着数十个惟妙惟肖的人像，旁边还标注了人物的信息，以及这些人在外出时最习惯伪装的模样。
毕竟深渊的异动近来愈发频繁，甚至根据前线最新传来的消息，那些从地底涌出的异族数量，已经开始呈现出暴增的趋势。
不仅如此，曾经爬出来的大多都是一些普通异族，靠城防军就能应付。
可如今却开始频繁出现各种力量强悍的怪物，其个体的强度，几乎已经与各个猎魔家族的首领不相上下。
为了应对这种局面，深渊附近如今已经部署了数十架中型猎龙弩，只要感知到强大的异族爬出裂隙，便会直接射杀。
content_en:
At the same time, several demon hunters from various top demon hunting families also noticed Caesar's movements.
The moment some of them saw the young man's appearance, their expressions suddenly froze, and their eyes were full of awe.
After the atmosphere was silent for a moment, one of the master demon hunters holding a special battle ax couldn't help but swallowed: "This one...isn't he also here to participate in the Warrior Ladder?"
Beside him, another master demon hunter with a magma fish emblem embroidered on his leather armor slowly shook his head, his eyes never leaving the young man's back.
"Probably not. Judging from the power this man showed on Hell Island, we are no different from ants in his eyes."
Behind the two of them, a master demon hunter with a waist full of magic potions also nodded. Even now when he thought of the battle on Hell Island, he still felt scared.
In the aftermath of a battle at that level, just getting close would risk death: "Judging from this person's strength, he is probably here to see the master."
In the end, a few people chatted in secret for a while, but gave up the idea of coming forward to talk.
The existence of the other party's level may have long been forgotten by ordinary demon hunters like them...
On the other side, Caesar ignored the prying eyes around him and still looked at the dragon man beside him with a smile.
The dragon-marked young man stared at Caesar with an unprecedented seriousness on his face: "Who are you?!"
The force just now was like an endless abyss. Even if I struggled with all my strength, I couldn't break free.
Even a father would never be able to feel this way. The gap is so big that people can't even think of resisting.
Caesar shrugged helplessly, being too lazy to answer a question that would take a long time to explain clearly.
My identity is too complicated to talk about. If I really wanted to talk about it, I wouldn't be able to even scratch the surface in a while.
"You brat, my old bones are falling apart!" Just when he was about to say a few perfunctory words, the feeble complaint of the old beggar came from behind.
The old beggar looked at the familiar yet unfamiliar Iceberg City in front of him, and couldn't help but sigh to himself... He was getting old after all.
Caesar patted the old beggar's shoulder lightly, and then looked at the panting Kasha and Sally behind him: "Then why are you following me? Do you also want to see Surte?"
A rare look of pride appeared on the old beggar's face. He patted his chest and pointed at the royal city: "I will reluctantly act as your guide for a while. There are many rules here... and there are also many difficult things."
As soon as the words fell, the dragon-marked young man beside him opened his eyes in shock, staring at Caesar's back.
He originally thought that this guy was a strong man who came to participate in the Warrior Ladder, but he didn't expect that he actually came to see the master.
"Caesar..." He stared at the young man's profile. He always felt that he had heard this name somewhere before. It seemed to be widely spread on the western border of the empire.
So he quickly took out a few pieces of parchment from his chest and began to carefully compare the patterns on them.
I saw dozens of lifelike portraits printed on the parchment, with information about the characters and the most common disguises of these people when going out.
After all, the unusual movements in the abyss have become more frequent recently, and even according to the latest news from the front line, the number of alien races emerging from the underground has begun to show a surge.
Not only that, most of the people who had crawled out were ordinary aliens, who could be dealt with by relying on the city defense army.
But now, various powerful monsters are beginning to appear frequently, and their individual strength is almost as strong as the leaders of various demon-hunting families.
In order to deal with this situation, dozens of medium-sized dragon-hunting crossbows have been deployed near the abyss. As long as they sense powerful aliens crawling out of the cracks, they will shoot them directly.
